title: Six doors rebuilt to the Claude Design handoff, a kit /for index, and a marketing-kit rule
detail: The /for/<niche> doors are rebuilt from the Claude Design zip (hero card, galaxy, tools, loop ring, example week, guide form, start pill) with SEO and GEO copy: answer-first cost answer, Where is Frequency available, North County San Diego and the December 1 opening in titles and descriptions. Verified at 1440 and 390 for all six doors. /for is now a kit index of the six doors in the (marketing) group, so it wears the standard header and footer. The doors now wear it too under Frequency (app/for/layout.tsx), per the handoff README; DAWN keeps the chrome-free door. The retired four-card grid that left an orphan under three is gone with the old door component. check:marketing-kit (ADR-1869) fails a new marketing page that hand-rolls Tailwind layout; seven legacy pages are on a shrink-only baseline. Open: the 'Your Space comes with Crew' line on the doors and funnel emails waits for PLAN_STORY.crewSpace (#3810).
